title: The Great Flood
text: The river decides to visit town. Your street is under a metre of water. {crush}'s cat is on a roof. {rival}'s jet ski is floating past, unattended.

ok.text: You save your laptop and three plants. The plants are dead, but they're yours.
You climb the roof and save the cat. The cat scratches you. {crush} kisses the scratches.

effects.remember: Saved {crush}'s cat from a roof during the flood.

fail.text: You slip off the roof into the water. The cat climbs down by itself and looks disappointed in you.

choices.label: Borrow {rival}'s jet ski and rescue everyone

ok.text: You save eleven people and a goat. The Gazette calls you a hero. {rival} calls the police.

effects.remember: Rescued half the street on {rival}'s jet ski.

fail.text: You crash {rival}'s jet ski into the war memorial. Everyone is fine. The memorial isn't.

choices.label: Wave to {friend}, who is paddling past in {friend.his} canoe

text.text: {friend} remembers who carried {friend.his} piano. {Friend.he} paddles over, saves your TV and gives you a lift to the pub.
{friend} paddles over and saves your TV. And you.

effects.remember: {friend} rescued you in a canoe during the flood.

choices.label: Set up a first aid station in the church

ok.text: You treat sprains, shock and one man who swallowed a goldfish. The town will never forget it.

effects.remember: Ran a first aid station in the church during the flood.

choices.label: Restart the broken flood pump at the waterworks

ok.text: You fix it with a bicycle chain and a lot of swearing. The water goes down. You're the town hero.

effects.remember: Restarted the flood pump with a bicycle chain.

title: The Great Blackout
text: A squirrel bites the wrong cable and the whole town loses power for three days. No phones, no internet, no fridge. People are talking to each other. It's terrifying.

choices.label: Organise a street party with everything in the freezers

ok.text: Forty people, two hundred fish fingers, one guitar. People still talk about it. Mostly about the fish fingers.

effects.remember: Threw a blackout street party with the whole street's freezers.

fail.text: It's a lovely idea until the prawns. Twelve people spend the night in the hospital, which also has no power.

choices.label: Light candles and finally talk to {crush}

ok.text: Three days of candlelight and nothing to do but talk. You learn {crush} hates squirrels. You agree.

effects.remember: Spent the blackout talking to {crush} by candlelight.

choices.label: Sell bags of ice at triple price

ok.text: You make a fortune. You also make enemies. The town's memory is long and the ice melts fast.

effects.remember: Sold ice at triple price in the blackout.

fail.text: You buy all the ice. It melts before you sell any. You now own a lot of water.

choices.label: Climb the pole and rewire the cable yourself

ok.text: The lights come back on. The whole town cheers. The squirrel is fine and now works for you.

effects.remember: Fixed the town's power cable after the squirrel incident.

choices.label: Organise a night watch so nobody gets robbed

ok.text: Nobody gets robbed. Three people get engaged. Two get lost. One is found in the bakery.

effects.remember: Kept the town safe in the blackout.
